glosses: humor; comic effect in a communication or performance

examples.en: You have a sense of humor.

examples.text: Il a le sens de l'humour.
examples.en: He has a sense of humor.
I love your sense of humor.

examples.text: Vous avez un bon sens de l'humour.
examples.en: You have a good sense of humor.

examples.text: Il semble n'avoir aucun sens de l'humour.
examples.en: He seems to have no sense of humor.
